notes: Clawpack 5.14.0 from PyPI (sdist sha256 b9f3208fe9e1d834122ae86e2af536a3010435d0d65e6629f360416ea9cffe89), built with gfortran 13.3 and used unchanged; the drivers are Benchmarks/open/other-codes/clawpack/blast_axi.py and room3d.py.

The ideal-gas balloon of ideal-gas-balloon-v1: no afterburning, radiation, gravity or mapped start. Histories imported and extracted with Scripts/open-benchmark/run_decks.py; receipt and hashes in Benchmarks/open/other-codes/clawpack/histories/.

cases.configuration: Clawpack 5.14.0 PyClaw ClassicClaw, unsplit wave propagation with transverse correction waves, Roe solver with entropy fix (riemann.euler_4wave_2D), MC limiter, CFL 0.45 (rejected above 0.5); the deck's density and pressure floors. NOT the deck's mesh: 2-D axisymmetric r-z, 62.5 mm square cells, 48 m in r and z; the axis and the rigid ground reflect, the outer faces extrapolate (zero gradient). Geometric source terms of cylindrical symmetry by a two-stage Runge-Kutta step, Godunov-split. The deck's balloon (1600 kg/m^3, 4.184 MJ/kg, gamma 1.4, released at t = 0, its mass and excess energy added to ambient air) built by the deck's sampling rule on r-z cells, each midpoint sample weighted by its radius; the 100 kg hemisphere, radius 0.3102 m. The deck's observable (pressure interpolated between cell centres, clamped, so a ground gauge reads the first row of cells), 50 us samples to 100 ms, and its read rules.
notes: A deviation from ideal-gas-balloon-v1, not an import of it: the deck fixes a 3-D Cartesian octant on 0.5 m cells and its discrete start; this is the same physics on a 2-D axisymmetric mesh.

The hemisphere is centred on the rigid ground, so the ground is a plane of symmetry: the reflected wave is the mirror image of the incident one, and the exact solution is the free-air sphere's. The run tests a 2-D grid with the ground as a boundary, not a different physics.

The cylindrical source terms are not conservative: the domain gained 2.08% of the charge's energy by the stop (0.016% from the floors), most of it in the first millisecond; see the README's mesh study.

cases.configuration: Clawpack 5.14.0 PyClaw ClassicClaw 3-D, unsplit wave propagation with transverse increment and correction waves, Roe solver with entropy fix (riemann.euler_3D), minmod limiter, CFL 0.45 (rejected above 0.5); the deck's density and pressure floors. The deck's mesh (the whole 6 m cube, 24 cells a side), walls on all six faces, the deck's initial_cells as given, its volume-mean observable, 50 us samples to 120 ms, and its 100-120 ms window. Differs from the deck only in the numerics it names for BombCAD's adapter (Roe and minmod, not HLLC with limiter theta 1.5; no startup steps).
notes: Total energy rose by 0.000% to 0.028% of the charge's over the 120 ms, all of it from the deck's pressure floor in the near-vacuum at the charge's centre; the scheme itself conserves it.
